column4: Part sales behave exactly as today; every new guard or branch on code shared with part sales is type-aware (service work orders only).
Webhook and portal suppression is test-covered: tests assert both that the internal path stays silent and that the billable path still fires.

Until the release run completes, the enable-setting endpoint refuses (deploy-time env switch, removed after launch) and the FE renders none of the new controls (the setting, the Internal customer checkbox, the line actions).

Money reports exclude whole internal/no-charge work orders and no-charge lines through two shared NULL-safe predicates (D58), wired in Phase 1 as no-ops on today's data with byte-compare tests; no billable figure changes to the cent.

the report carries the helper "Parts cost is the amount at Close. A special order billed after Close at a different amount is not updated here; with QuickBooks or AccountingHub the bill posts its own amount."
the asset Invoices tab shows "No charge" in Total balance with Discount and Tax rate empty, and its rows have no actions
